# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.1.0

- Adds Manual stem preparation with always-visible Vocals, Drums, and Harmonics / Other slots. Drop or browse for files and keep assignments between sessions.
- Adds imported-stem previews, timing and file checks, and comparison with the original track and packaged USB audio.
- Adds a hardware-based processing-speed recommendation and adjustable track overlap. Preparation and packaging can run alongside separation, and the model stays loaded between songs where memory permits.
- Fixes excess timing padding for MP3 sources without encoder-delay metadata. Regenerate and package previously affected automatic stems to apply the correction.
- Adds support for reading rekordbox libraries and packaging stems on Mac OS Extended (Journaled) USBs on macOS.
- Improves reading newly exported rekordbox Device Library Plus databases.
- Adds macOS file-access setup and clearer guidance for granting music-folder and removable-volume access.
- Simplifies preparation-mode and preview controls, and adds a Discord help and updates link.

This app update works with existing compatible OverCue firmware; it does not install a player firmware update.
